result.topic_en: Draft notes on the ear as a mechanical apparatus of extreme sensitivity, estimating how weak the mechanical force of sound reaching the ear can be (citing Nicholson's report of hearing gunfire at 4-5 miles), comparing intensities at different distances, and relating this to the sensitivity of the eye.
